name: aiochainscan
description: Read-only blockchain data: balances, transactions, tokens, holders, contract ABIs, ENS.
long_description: Twelve read-only tools over Etherscan, BlockScout and NodeReal, served by the `aiochainscan` Python client. Works keylessly against BlockScout; an Etherscan or NodeReal key widens coverage. Every tool answers an envelope of `{data, notes, instructions, pagination}` with opaque pagination cursors, exact Wei math (no float division) and EIP-55 addresses, and transaction input decoded against the verified ABI.

etherscan_key.title: Etherscan API key
etherscan_key.description: Optional. Without it the server uses the keyless BlockScout scanner, which serves fewer methods.

nodereal_key.title: NodeReal API key
nodereal_key.description: Optional. Used only for BSC chains, which have no BlockScout instance.

default_scanner.title: Default scanner
default_scanner.description: Scanner for tools that do not pass one: blockscout, blockscout_v2, etherscan or nodereal. Empty means blockscout.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Native-coin balance as a Wei string plus a human-readable amount

tools.name: get_address_overview
tools.description: Composite snapshot: balance, newest transactions, ERC-20 and NFT holdings

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Curated transaction pages with opaque cursors

tools.name: get_transaction_info
tools.description: Transaction details with the call input decoded against the verified ABI

tools.name: get_token_portfolio
tools.description: ERC-20 holdings of an address, curated and paginated

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Token metadata, supply (raw and formatted) and holder count

tools.name: get_token_holders
tools.description: Token holder pages with totals and human-readable balances

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Verified-ABI summary: function and event signatures

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: eth_call against a verified contract, ABI fetched automatically, outputs decoded

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Chains this installation can serve, with a substring filter
